body: The darkness seemed to grow colder around me as I noticed the passengers on the platform huddle closer together, their faces illuminated only by the flickering streetlights outside. My heartbeat quickened at the thought of staying beside those who felt the need for protection more than ever tonight. I took a deep breath, my palms slick with sweat but filled with an indescribable sense of duty and empathy. With hands clasped gently over mine where they rested on her shoulder, I whispered softly, "We're all in this together." She looked up at me, her eyes reflecting my own thoughts and worries. Without hesitation, I nodded reassuringly and held out a hand for her to take mine. Together, we formed a human chain, offering each other strength through the cold night ahead.
